retrievalProfile.description: A radial collage of group portraits framed by circular repeating typography on a clean off-white background.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central cluster of overlapping portraits arranged in a circular, kaleidoscopic fashion, surrounded by a ring of repeating lowercase text, set against a plain cream-colored field with bold display type at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Radial symmetry of the central photo collage
Circular path of the secondary typography framing the subject
High contrast between the purple display text and the yellow accent sticker
Clean negative space surrounding the central circular motif
coreInvariants: Circular repetition of text along a path

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central circular cluster of portraits occupying approximately 60% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large purple display text at the top center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top title, moves down to the central faces, then follows the circular text ring around the perimeter.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open space in the corners and around the central circular element.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep purple for primary display text
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright yellow for the circular call-out sticker
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the text and accents against a low-saturation, high-value background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif and geometric sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Display text uses thick, rounded slab serifs with tight kerning
Secondary text follows a perfect circular path
Call-out text is condensed and sans-serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: Tight ligatures between heavy slab characters
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy decorative slab for the title paired with a neutral, clean sans-serif for the circular path text.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, rounded slab-serif aesthetic of the 70s.
Suitable for the secondary text and call-out sticker.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a central radial collage of 5-6 men's portraits in a kaleidoscopic arrangement on a plain cream background. Leave a wide circular margin around the collage.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large purple slab-serif title at the top. Place a repeating lowercase phrase in a dark grey sans-serif font along a circular path that frames the central collage. Add a yellow circular sticker in the top left corner with condensed black text.

verificationChecks: Is the text following a perfect circle?
Is the background a clean, solid cream color?
Are the portraits arranged in a radial, overlapping pattern?
Is the primary title in a heavy, rounded purple font?

adjustableVariables: Number of portraits in the collage
Diameter of the circular text path
mustRedesign: Transcribed lyrics or specific artist names
Specific faces from the source image

mustAchieve: Balanced radial symmetry in the collage
avoid: Jagged edges on the photo collage
Illegible text on the circular path

postGenerationChecks: Check that the circular text is legible and not overlapping itself.
Ensure the purple title is the most prominent element.
Verify the cream background is consistent and free of artifacts.
Confirm the kaleidoscopic effect of the portraits is centered.
recipe.reuseFormula: Radial Collage + Circular Path Typography + Heavy Slab Title + Cream Field
